result.summary: The quote visit with Harbour Surveying was booked for the morning of 08/10/2024. As of 10/10 nothing has come back about it: no report, no quote, no word on whether anyone turned up (event 025). I emailed the contractor asking whether the visit happened, what they found and what the quote is, and texted the tenant asking whether the engineer came. A hold is set to chase in 2 days. Nothing here needs agency judgement yet, so I haven't escalated.

judgement.why_this_decision: The visit was confirmed for 08/10/2024 at 08:30 (events 020-024). The system flagged 'No work results' on 10/10 (event 025). There are no attachments and both contractor emails (events 011, 017) have no text, so we can't tell whether the visit happened. Both the contractor and the tenant can answer this, so I asked them before escalating. No cost or approval decision is due until a quote arrives. The landlord was told on 01/10 that an engineer would be sent to diagnose the fault (event 002).

alternatives_considered.why_not: Asking the contractor and tenant can probably settle what happened. This is the first chase after the visit, so it isn't a case of no response after two follow-up deadlines.
Nothing shows the visit happened or that any repair was done. It was a quote visit, not approved works.
Too early. Harbour Surveying did book and confirm the visit. If they don't respond again, raise it with a human.
There's no quote or decision to put to her yet. I'll update her once there is a diagnosis or quote.
